scope: Read-only original iOS14.0 beta5 18A5351d routing and virtual HID authorization inspection; no guest inputs or policy changes.

sources.backboardd_origin: Unchanged System volume from prepared13-container.apfs; extracted Volume1/usr/libexec/backboardd outside Git.

sender_path.no_service: At 0x1c23a3dd8 lookup senderID in sender cache; 0x1c23a1be4 senderInfoForSenderID returns BKHIDUnknownSender.unknownSenderInfo on a dictionary miss (0x1c23a1cd4). No service at 0x1c23a3f10 logs unknown sender and forwards unknown sender object.
sender_path.zero_limit: No special zero ID branch in inspected lookup or initializer (0x1c23a1f28). Runtime cache contents and upstream transformations have not been observed; this does not prove every externally dispatched sender0 event is dropped.
sender_path.accessibility: Original accessibilityHIDServices 0x1c2391db0 creates seven reserved nonzero IDs, not zero. These are not authorized identities for an owned helper to impersonate.
sender_path.backboard_processor: BKHIDDigitizerEventProcessor processEvent:sender:dispatcher: 0x100048d68 accepts BKHIDAccessibilitySender or BKIOHIDService; other classes lead to ignoring digitizer event from non-digitizer sender log at 0x100049128. Accessibility path obtains mainDisplayDigitizerService at 0x100048ed0, so it is not proof of service-independent touch.
sender_path.display_integrated: Original processor reads field0xb0019 at 0x100048ef8. Its presence alone does not satisfy sender/service checks.
sender_path.unresolved: Global normalized coordinate contract, complete display selection, and event acceptance remain unproven. Do not substitute app-local UIKit enqueue/context semantics.
sender_path.integrated_display_rule: Original backboardd0x100049018–0x100049038 requires (service.displayUUID != nil) XOR service.isBuiltIn ==1; else unsupported-service log. For integrated touchscreen this means Built-In=true and no external displayUUID. Usage mask at0x10004905c–0x100049080 accepts page0xD usages1,4,0x20. BKDigitizerArbiterAccess matcher:servicesDidMatch:0x100088a60 checks isBuiltIn before touchscreen usage0xD0004 may become mainDisplayDigitizerService.

virtual_device_candidate.user_api: IOHIDUserDeviceCreateWithOptions: original recovery0x47df8, corresponding System IOKit mapping base0x1812d3000. Matches IOHIDResource at0x47eb8, IOServiceOpen type0 at0x47ee8.
virtual_device_candidate.kernel_auth: IOHIDResourceDeviceUserClient::initWithTask 0xfffffff00834397c calls copyClientEntitlement for com.apple.hid.manager.user-access-device at0xfffffff0083439d8 or com.apple.developer.hid.virtual.device at0xfffffff008343a38; OSBoolean true required. Developer true branch0xfffffff008343a80 reaches successful initializer0xfffffff008343c0c.
virtual_device_candidate.privilege: Manager path sets byte+0x168; developer path does not. createDevice 0xfffffff008345988–0xfffffff0083459e8 sets Privileged from that internal flag. Do not supply Privileged or impersonate an existing provider.
virtual_device_candidate.limits: This establishes original userclient authorization only. A real virtual digitizer must be created from an owned HID report descriptor and observed as an OS-assigned service; matching, BackBoard acceptance and actual UI response still require execution evidence.
virtual_device_candidate.built_in_propagation: Original IOHIDEventService::start copies provider Built-In at0xfffffff00831e718–0xfffffff00831e724; checks OSBoolean type at0xfffffff00831e73c; sets same boolean on event service at0xfffffff00831e76c–0xfffffff00831e778. No Privileged condition occurs in this property-copy branch. Original IOHIDUserDevice::initWithProperties0xfffffff008342c0c preserves supplied dictionary and uses Privileged only to force HIDVirtualDevice=true at0xfffffff008342cac–0xfffffff008342d94. An honestly named VM-integrated virtual device can use Built-In routing metadata without claiming Apple hardware identity; it remains virtual.
